counter_only_replay.scope: Counter-only causal replay, holding the recorded signals/fills fixed; not a complete strategy or tick-path replay.

additional_live_safety_check.method: Frozen-clock test of AtlasTrader._evaluate_safety_layer followed by _guard_block_reason; isolate repaired streak=1, normal volatility, no retrospective loss-memory input.
additional_live_safety_check.limitation: This assumes timely broker-close reconciliation and no already-consumed cooldown marker. It does not reconstruct all runtime flags or asynchronous event timing.

conclusions: Counter repair alone does not prevent the first recorded loss; the entry and stop logic are unchanged.
The hard streak limit alone permits both recorded entries. Its conditional -35.05 result is not a full-system replay prediction.
The same repaired streak also feeds existing adaptive safety: one loss arms a 12-minute cooldown. With prompt reconciliation this blocks the rapid second attempt.
Closed-M5 replay produced zero trades, but cannot reproduce the two intrabar actual entries. Do not interpret zero trades as proof the live losses are avoided.
No profitability or complete live-policy parity is established. No strategy, risk thresholds or stop sizes were changed.
